name: Saskatchewan
short: Saskatchewan has little rebate money for homes in 2026. SaskEnergy pays $325 to $1,000 when you replace a gas furnace, boiler or water heater with a high-efficiency unit, and SaskPower's Energy Assistance Program gives free energy-saving upgrades. SaskPower's retrofit rebate ended in April 2026, and we found no provincial rebate for heat pumps, insulation or windows.

rows.rules: Natural gas unit on SaskEnergy's list. TSASK-licensed gas contractor. Apply within 120 days.
Homeowners, renters and landlords. Check eligibility online.

rows.rules: SaskPower says the retrofit rebate has ended.
